RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for  ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday,  the April 29, 2008/Vaisakha 9, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Civil Aviation; Corporate Affairs; Culture; Finance;
Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and
Natural Gas; Tourism; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
159
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Losses incurred by PSU, oil
companies and refineries
*501. SHRI RAHUL BAJAJ: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) what is the value of losses incurred
by PSU, oil producing companies and oil
refining companies during 2006-07 and
2007-08, due to Government control on
petroleum prices, and
(b) in what ratio have these losses been
absorbed by oil producing companies, oil
refining companies and Government
respectively?
Capital investment by oil companies
in foreign countries
†*502. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
oil companies are making capital investment
in construction of basic facilities in other
countries;
(b) if so, the names of such companies
whose proposals to make capital
investment in different countries are under
consideration till now, the details of amount
involved and the names of such countries;
and
(c) the estimated percentage of profit
from this capital investment?
Buddhist heritage centre in Orissa
*503. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY:
SHRI B. J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government of Sri Lanka
has asked its Indian counterpart to develop
Buddhist sites in the Southern sector,

160
i.e. Andhra Pradesh and Orissa, to facilitate
Buddhist tourists to visit such heritage
centres;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what is the action plan of
Government to develop such Buddhist
heritage centres in Orissa to promote
Buddhist tourism in that State?
Role of private companies in Civil
Aviation
*504. PROF. P. J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the expansion of Metro
Airports has been entrusted to private
companies;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether ground handling and
ensuring security at these airports have also
been entrusted to them; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Multiple airports in big cities
*505. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to build more
than one airport in big cities;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any such policy has been
framed;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Interlinking of rivers as National
Project
*506. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) what is preventing Government to
declare inter-linking of rivers in the country
as a National Project;
(b) whether Government would declare
any time bound action plan in order to
implement the National Project; and
(c) if so, whether Government is
considering to make a provision in the
Eleventh Five Year Plan for the funds
required for the project?
Permission to NetJet for operating in
India
*507. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARW AL: Will the Minister of  CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has given
permission to NetJet to operate in India
with an Indian strategic partner;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the terms
and conditions of the permission granted;
(c) whether security clearance from
Government has been obtained by NetJet
for foray into Indian market; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Construction of Pulichintala Project
in Andhra Pradesh
*508. SHRI C. RAMA-
CHANDRAIAH: Will the Minister of
W ATER RESOURCES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that to provide
irrigation facilities to some of the districts

161
of Andhra Pradesh, the State Government
is constructing the Pulichintala Project
across Krishna river;
(b) if so, whether any slippages have
been noticed while constructing the project;
(c) if so, the details of cost and time
overruns, the reasons for slippages and the
measures taken to arrest them along with
their impact;
(d) the districts of Andhra Pradesh
which would be covered by the project;
and
(e) by when the project would be
completed and total area of land that would
be irrigated?
Revision of pay in Public Sector
Banks/Insurance Companies
*509. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the pay revision of Public
Sector Banks and Insurance Companies is
due and the employees and workers'
organisations have already given their
demand;
(b) if so, by when Government is going
to start the negotiation with these
organisations; and
(c) whether these organisations of
employees and officers are demanding long
term settlement for five years?
Approval of CCEA for investment by
foreign companies
*510. SHRI SYED AZEEZ
PASH
